description: Travaux de voirie impactant la circulation automobile sur Rennes Métropole pour le jour courant is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Délimitation des travaux de voirie générant des perturbations pour la circulation automobile pour le jour courant. Cette information est mise à jour en continu par les services de la voirie et de la communication de Rennes Métropole. Cette couche est consultable par le grand public à travers le site. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are travaux publics, route, transport terrestre, planification des transports. The portal shows 339 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-01-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
